run_similarity_check_training: run the similarity check model training loop with GNN and transformer encoder on assembly code graphs
validate_model_with_map_at_r: validate the trained model using cosine similarity and compute MAP@R metric on the validation split
test_model_with_compute_metrics: test the trained model and compute MAP@R, AP, and AUPRG metrics on the test split
create_circleloss_criterion: create a CircleLoss criterion with configurable gamma and margin parameters for similarity learning
build_code_sim_asm_model: build a CODE_SIM_ASM_Model combining a Graph_NN and Encoder for assembly code similarity embedding
